calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Thornmaw (the Black Hound), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Thornmaw, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Thornmaw's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A slight, quiet young woman, small and light, a head shorter than the other riders, with a calm face: pale skin, deep-set dark eyes with a faint violet tint, a small straight nose and a tight, unsmiling mouth. Short tousled brown hair, side-swept with one stray tuft over the ear, ending at the jaw. A long dark charcoal-violet hooded cloak with a ragged hem reaching the calves, over a plum-black high-collared coat. A deep red wool scarf at her throat. Heavy bronze chains with dark iron links cross her chest and loop at the hip. Black leather trousers, dark brown ankle boots with bronze buckles, black fingerless gloves. WEAPON: a slender war scythe about as tall as her head and shoulders, with a black bramble-wrapped haft studded with tiny thorns, and a narrow, sickle-thin blade of smoke-black steel whose inner edge is serrated with thorn-like points that glow violet. Both hands grip it: the RIGHT low on the haft, the LEFT high near the blade's neck; the blade always leads to the right. Trails and smoke are VIOLET-PURPLE. The shadow hound is a separate summon, never present in her standing or attacking poses; it appears only in her Rift Art.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right; a standing idle with the scythe planted butt-first; a walking pose; a running pose with the scythe over the shoulder
- upper middle row: a low crouch; a wide low reaping sweep with a violet arc; a fast diagonal reap from overhead
- lower middle row: a mid-air dive-slash; a plunge with the blade driven down; a low spinning reap skimming the ground; a long dragging hook
- bottom row: standing guard with the scythe across the body; a hit reaction; knocked down; a victory pose with the scythe planted; the Night Hunt special move (her and the hound leaping and slamming down)
- inset at the top right: the shadow hound alone in side view, large and dark with violet glowing eyes, its shoulder height about her head height, in the same style, as an identity reference only
- inset at the top left: the scythe alone, small, showing the bramble-wrapped haft and the thin thorned blade from the side
- all figures share one costume, one scythe design and one scale
- the hound appears only in the special move and its inset
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
